props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Set on Table.Root. Opt-in sticky mode. Renders a single, well-defined scroll viewport (`cn-table-v2-viewport`) so sticky-positioned cells (e.g. sticky headers) resolve against one deterministic scroll container. When unset, the DOM structure and overflow behavior are unchanged.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Set on Table.Root. Maximum height of the scroll viewport. Only applies in sticky mode.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Set on Table.Root. Ref forwarded to the scroll viewport element. Only applies in sticky mode.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Set on Table.Root. Optional overlay rendered as a sibling of `<table>` inside the scroll viewport. Used by DataTable for a column-resize indicator that is not clipped by header cells.
